source_authority.incident_summary: Spec-fidelity LLM-only / non-deterministic / phantom-ID gate: 5 runs on identical input produced 4 distinct HIGH counts (A4:F-A4-005); TUIBBS v1-MVP produced 54 phantom_id HIGH findings from the lenient D-family extractor vs strict comparator (A12:F-A12-01). Contract #4/#9 replaces LLM-judged severity with a deterministic roadmap_ids subset-of spec_ids union accepted_deviations containment check that runs before any severity classification.

expected_failure_substring: Contract #9: roadmap contains 5 IDs not in spec
expected_contract_4_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (LLM-judged severity emitted a non-deterministic HIGH count on phantom IDs, with the binary high_severity_count==0 halt unable to distinguish fabricated IDs from LLM variance), MUST PASS post-fix (the deterministic _roadmap_ids_within_spec containment check identically reports the same 5 surface-form phantom IDs on every run, before any severity step).
